client.text:
Hello! I can help you with the Old Age Pension, but applications are currently closed.

Applications closed on 01/10/2026 at 00:00 IST, so nothing can be filed right now. I have no information about when the next application window will open.

For reference, the scheme details are:
- **Amount:** Rs 250 per month
- **Who qualifies:** Residents of Purvanchal aged 60 or above
- **Documents accepted for age proof:** Birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or Voter ID
- **Decision time:** 15 days. If no officer decides within 15 days, the application is approved automatically.

If you tell me your date of birth, I can check whether you meet the age requirement. I can't file an application while the window is closed.
